responsibility: This file provides the VR4300 pipeline scheduling overrides for GCC’s MIPS backend. It replaces generic timings with VR4300-specific latencies for loads and coprocessor transfers, 32-bit and 64-bit integer multiply/divide, and the core floating-point move, add, multiply, divide, reciprocal-divide, sqrt, and reciprocal-sqrt operations, so instruction scheduling matches the VR4300 execution costs.
